name: AiSuperSmart

sources.title: About Us — live Indian WordPress AI tool directory (1000+ tools); nav shows Submit Tool link to /submit-tool/
Submit Tool — returned a JS verification interstitial ('Please wait while your request is being verified'); form not readable

conditions: Submission is advertised as free ('Submit your Ai Tool On Our Site For Free')
The submit page is gated by a JS bot-verification challenge and likely requires an account — Login/Register (Google sign-in) appears in the nav and popup
requirements: AI tools only — directory covers 1000+ tools across use-case categories
Free submission per the site's own marketing (LinkedIn and directory copy)
Account likely required — login popup and /sign-up/ exist
preparation: A browser that passes the JS verification challenge — plain fetches get the 'Please wait' interstitial
Tool name, URL, category, description, logo
workflow: Open https://www.aisupersmart.com/submit-tool/ in a real browser and pass the verification
Complete the submission form (fields not visible to text fetch)
watchFor: Aggressive bot-check on many routes — automated submission needs a real browser
Several nav links are malformed (double-domain URLs like /aisupersmart.com/submit-tool/) — use the clean /submit-tool/ path
Small WordPress directory run by a two-person Indian team — expect informal review
Site mixes its own AI tools, blog, and directory — distinguish the directory listing from their 'Our Tools' features
countsAsLive: The tool has a page under aisupersmart.com/ai-tools-directory/<slug>/ or appears in the homepage tool grid
unknowns: Exact submission form fields behind the JS check
Whether an account is strictly required
